items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: we was like Charlie and Louie and them

ctx.x: Who was the leader of that band that played that night? That was Buddy Petit. But I believe

it was, I believe Sharky was the other band over there if I'm not mistaken. Well there's a whole lot been going on here up in here since I've done. I don't believe I can, I don't believe he got the, what, animal decisions I could bring this up much about outside of Charlie. I don't know. Talk about it. Charlie's about the army and, well, Pete's all right too, but Pete wasn't like us. Pete was more of an auction man, but we was like Charlie and Louie and them, they didn't carry but full pieces, you see. Well that…
How about Kid Thomas in those days? Did you play much with Thomas in the early days?
